SELECTED PROJECT — AI research engineering

Local SLM Lab

A local experimental environment for evaluating and fine-tuning small language models with versioned corpora and repeatable tests.

View source on GitHub ↗
Focus
AI research engineering
Stack
Python · Qwen · LoRA · llama.cpp
Format
Project case study
The work

From problem to system.

The problem

A useful model experiment needs more than a promising response: the data, evaluation prompts, guardrails, and results must be comparable over time.

The approach

The lab separates training material from a frozen evaluation set, documents local inference with llama.cpp and Qwen, and includes a LoRA fine-tuning workflow and scoring rubric.

01
Keep datasets versioned

Training corpora and evaluation cases are documented separately.

02
Run local models

Small models can be tested in a local inference workflow.

03
Compare results

A repeatable evaluation set and scoring rubric support comparisons across variants.

This is an experiment and evaluation workflow. It does not claim a published paper or a production model.
